verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens for scripts, CI jobs and tools that carry only the permissions you grant and always expire. Its MCP connections can also be limited to selected repositories, so an agent can be given least-privilege credentials. missing for 10: an enumerated permission/scope list, a dedicated agent or service identity separate from the user (tokens act 'as you'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A personal access token lets scripts, CI jobs and tools use the REST API or Git over HTTPS as you, with only the permissions you grant. Tokens start with `gct_` and always expire.
Choose the repository access: **All repositories you can access** (the default...) or **Only select repositories…**
GitCafe runs an MCP server at `https://git.cafe/mcp`, so AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT can read repositories and, with your approval, work on issues and pull requests.
